Name: Haley To Max Caulfield
Author: olivespectre
Description:
[size=3]Ever wanted to move to the world of the [i]Life is Strange[/i] universe? Maybe wanted to hmph... [i]"flirt"[/i] with the protagonist or other characters? Now you can! (Not quite, you actually cannot XD) With our mod called HaleyToTheMax you can now date, talk and live with the main protagonist of the Life is Strange game! Enjoy and please support my amateur but yet demanding work by donating me! Thanks and may the [i]shaka brah[/i] be with you!
[/size]
[size=3][b]Installing:[/b][/size]

Simply put the downloaded (and unpacked) folder into the game's mods folder and run the game!

[b][size=3]Uninstalling:

[/size][/b]Just remove the folder from mods folder. Boom.

PS.
This mod changes everything about Haley from portraits to in-game character so you don't have to worry about anything! Even the seasonal and beach clothes are changed here, canonically accurately :)

Also[b] [/b][b]Credits to Poltergeister & Jazzybee[/b] for their lovely portrait maker!!
